©• FOREWORD 

©•1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 2 August 1974, after the draft finalized by the Magnetic Components and 
Fcrrite Materials Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electro- 
technical Division Council. 

©•2 In preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from the follow- 
ing publications, issued by the International Electrotcrhnical Commission: 

lEC Pub 221-1966 Dimensions of screw cores made of ferromagnetic 

oxides 
lEC Pub 221A.1972 First supplement to Publication 221-1966 

03 For the purpose of deriding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is compHcd with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing 
the result of a test, shall be roimdcd off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The 
number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the 
same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions and their tolerances essential to 
ensure interchangeability of screw cores of ferromagnetic oxides. This applies 
to the following two types of screw cores: 

Type A Screw cores ( threaded cores ) primarily for use in pre-threadcd 

coil formers. 
Type B Screw cores ( threaded cores ) suitable for cutting directly in 

the coil former. 

2. TYPE A SCREW GOHES 

2.1 This type is primarily designed for use in pre-threaded coil former$ with 
locking material, generally organic material, between the screw core and the 
female thread. Tliey may, however, also be used as self-tapping screws in 
plain or ribbed coil formers. 

*'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ) . 



ISt 7430- 1974 



2.2 Scrwfw Threacls for Type A Screw Cores 

2.2*1 The screw threads of these screw cores shall be adapted to the 
standard metric female threads, indicated by the nominal major diameter 
and nominal pitch. 

2.2»2 The profile of the screw threads for Type A screw cores is shown in 
Fig. 1 and their dimensions shall be as given in Table 1.
